title: DUGO: Dual-Scale Gaussian Memory for Online Temporal Action Localization in Egocentric Procedural Videos
abstract: arXiv:2610.41402v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Online Temporal Action Localization (OnTAL) aims to detect and localize action instances from untrimmed streaming videos in real time. Unlike offline approaches, OnTAL models have no access to future frames and cannot go back and refine earlier predictions, which makes the task considerably harder given the strict real-time constraints and narrow temporal window available. Most existing OnTAL methods lean on either brief anchor-based context or a single-scale memory of past frames, which limits how well they can capture actions unfolding across multiple time scales or requiring long-range reasoning in Procedural Videos. To address these gaps, we present DUGO (Dual-Scale Encoding and Gaussian Memory Online), a new OnTAL framework that jointly models local motion dynamics and long-range temporal dependencies. translated_title: DUGO：面向第一人称程序性视频在线时序动作定位的双尺度高斯记忆
translated_abstract: 在线时序动作定位旨在从未修剪的流式视频中实时检测和定位动作实例。与离线方法不同，OnTAL 模型无法访问未来帧，也无法回头修正先前的预测，这在严格的实时约束和狭窄的可用时间窗口下使该任务变得相当困难。大多数现有的 OnTAL 方法依赖于简短的基于锚点的上下文或过去帧的单尺度记忆，这限制了它们捕捉在程序性视频中跨越多个时间尺度展开、或需要长程推理的动作的能力。为了解决这些不足，我们提出了 DUGO（双尺度编码与高斯记忆在线），这是一个新的 OnTAL 框架，它联合建模局部运动动态和长程时间依赖关系。其核心是 DUGO 使用双尺度时序编码器，将深度局部表示与全局自注意力相结合，从而可以……
tldr: DUGO 提出了一种结合双尺度时序编码器与高斯记忆的在线时序动作定位框架，通过联合建模局部运动动态与长程时间依赖，实现了第一人称程序性视频中动作的实时检测与定位。
en_tdlr: DUGO is a novel online temporal action localization framework that combines a dual-scale temporal encoder with Gaussian memory to jointly model local motion dynamics and long-range temporal dependencies, enabling real-time action detection in egocentric procedural videos.
